subject: اللغة الإنجليزية
outcomes: I can count body parts and say There is … / There are …
I can ask and answer Is there …? Are there …?
I can write about a funny monster.

tf.s: We say There is for one thing.
We say There are for more than one.

tf.why: Two arms is more than one: There are two arms.
One head: There is a head.

tf.s: Are there three legs? Yes, there are.
tf.why: Well done! That is a short answer.

tf.s: Is there one arm? No, there isn't.
tf.why: Yes! No, there isn't is the short answer.

tf.s: Is there one arm? Yes, there are.
tf.why: With Is there we answer Yes, there is.

tf.s: There are seven heads is about one head.
tf.why: Seven heads is more than one.

tf.s: Head, feet, arm, hand and leg are body words.
tf.why: Great! They are parts of the body.
We say one foot, two feet.

boxes.q: When do we say There are?
boxes.why: There are is for more than one.

boxes.q: The robot has got one head.
boxes.why: One head: There is one head.

boxes.q: There are seven feet. (8 in the picture) Correct it!

boxes.why: A hand is part of the body.

hunt.q: Are there two arms? Yes, there…
Is there a tail? No, there…
Are there ten legs? No, there…
We hold a pencil with it.

mcq.q: Which sentence is for one thing?
Which is the right answer? Are there three legs?
Which word is a body word?
mcq.why: A leg is part of the body.

mcq.q: Which question is for one thing?
A monster has 4 arms. Describe it.
mcq.why: Four arms: There are four arms.

mcq.q: Is there one arm on the robot? (It has four arms.)
o: No, there isn't. There are four arms.
No, there aren't. There is one arm.
mcq.why: It has four arms, not one.

mcq.q: Write about your monster: one head.
mcq.why: One head: There is one head.
Three legs is more than one: There are.

mcq.q: A robot has 2 heads and 2 more heads. Which is right?
mcq.why: Two and two make four: There are four heads.

mcq.q: Why do we say There are two arms, not There is two arms?
o: Two arms is more than one.
mcq.why: There are is for more than one.
